cues.en: Mike Cohen: This video is another unsupervised learning project.
cues.zh: Mike Cohen：這部影片是另一個「非監督式學習」專題。

cues.en: So this is like a mini code project.
cues.zh: 也就是一個小型程式專題。

cues.en: It's a little challenge for you, and I'm not going to give you my solution.
cues.zh: 給你一個小挑戰，而且我不會提供我的解答。

cues.en: I'm just going to explain the problem.
cues.zh: 我只會說明問題。

cues.en: It's up to you to come up with the details of the problem and it's up to you to solve that problem.
cues.zh: 問題的細節由你自己決定，也由你自己解決。

cues.en: Okay, so what you want to do here is create an asymmetric violin plot.
cues.zh: 好，這裡要做的是建立不對稱的小提琴圖。

cues.en: Now, I've already mentioned this term in the previous, or I guess it was two videos ago in the slides.
cues.zh: 我在前一部，或者應該是前兩部影片的投影片中，已經提過這個詞。

cues.en: An asymmetric violin plot basically just means that you're showing a violin plot for two datasets at the same time.
cues.zh: 不對稱的小提琴圖，基本上就是同時展示兩組資料的小提琴圖。

cues.en: One dataset is visualized on the left and the other dataset is visualized on the right.
cues.zh: 一組資料呈現在左側，另一組呈現在右側。

cues.en: So I will leave it up to you to find, to figure out which kinds of data sets you want to create this from.
cues.zh: 至於要使用哪種資料集，就留給你自己決定。

cues.en: For example, you might wanna have dataset one be exactly this, which we already created, and maybe dataset two is going to be a normal distribution,
cues.zh: 例如，第一組資料可以完全使用我們已經建立的這一組，第二組也許改成常態分布，

cues.en: so not a log distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是不要使用對數分布。

cues.en: Or maybe you take the square of these values instead of pushing them through the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 或者你可以將這些數值平方，而不是送入自然指數函數。

cues.en: So it's up to you.
cues.zh: 由你決定。

cues.en: You want to create a second dataset, just make sure that it's roughly in the same numeric range.
cues.zh: 你要建立第二組資料，只要確保數值範圍大致相同。

cues.en: If you have your other dataset that has values that go from 1000 to 2000, then it's, it's not going to be a very useful asymmetric violin plot.
cues.zh: 如果另一組資料的數值介於 1000 到 2000，這張不對稱小提琴圖就不會太有用。

cues.en: Okay so the dataset two should be roughly in the same range, somewhere around, you know, values of zero to five or six approximately, and make that be on the other side of this violin plot.
cues.zh: 所以第二組資料應該落在大致相同的範圍，例如約為 0 到 5 或 6，並呈現在小提琴圖的另一側。

cues.en: Now you can do this manually if you like, based on the code that you see here.
cues.zh: 如果願意，你可以根據這裡的程式手動完成。

cues.en: You can try and do it using functions that you might find online.
cues.zh: 也可以試著使用在網路上找到的函式。

cues.en: This is an outcome oriented project, so you don't have to feel compelled though to write all the code, to do everything from scratch.
cues.zh: 這個專題以成果為導向，所以不用覺得非得親自撰寫所有程式、從零完成每一件事。

cues.en: You can use tools as you can find online.
cues.zh: 可以使用在網路上找到的工具。

cues.en: The goal is the outcome, and if you get a really nice outcome, if you get a really nice asymmetric violin plot and you would like to share your hard work with me
cues.zh: 目標是做出成果。如果你的成果很漂亮，做出很棒的不對稱小提琴圖，而且想和我

cues.en: and with your fellow students, then feel free to post a screenshot of your results to the Q and A forum.
cues.zh: 以及其他同學分享你的努力成果，歡迎把結果的截圖貼到問答討論區。

cues.en: Oh yeah, and finally of course, if you're working in Python, you know, I just have the MATLAB screen open here, but you can do this in MATLAB or in Python.
cues.zh: 對了，最後當然要說，如果你使用 Python，雖然我這裡開的是 MATLAB 畫面，但你可以用 MATLAB 或 Python 完成。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter which language you work in.
cues.zh: 使用哪一種語言都沒有關係。
